description: Court filing PDF. Identify the entry with simple_name and item_number. Step 1: cost preview — omit accept_charge/download or set false. Step 2: after user confirms, call with the same simple_name and item_number plus accept_charge:true or download:true to purchase and download (signed URL). The response identifies the case by simpleName. Pulls from PACER when needed.

accept_charge.description: Optional. Omit or false for cost preview only. true after the user explicitly approves the previewed cost.

docket_id.description: Optional. A docket entry id already known to the caller. Responses identify filings by simpleName and item_number instead.

download.description: Optional legacy alias for accept_charge:true (some connectors cannot pass accept_charge).

item_number.description: Docket item number (e.g. 1 for the petition). Use with simple_name.

name: get_document_tool
